summary: Reproduced the scheduler metadata corruption (a 1024-token chunk inside a 1500-token encoder produced extend_num_tokens=-476 and AssertionError: Expected 0, got -476). Prefill admission now treats an uncached encoder region as atomic for encoder-decoder models: it defers the request when earlier admissions consumed the chunk budget, or admits the whole encoder when the encoder itself exceeds an empty batch's configured chunk size. Decoder-only multimodal chunking is unchanged.
